title: Pharmacy Spending Met by a Supplemental Benefit Card on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Enrollment
content:
What a supplemental benefit card met at a pharmacy never counts toward the out-of-pocket total on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan, and the amount so met is read from the member's Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes holding: the standing of that card programme, its own quarterly over-the-counter sublimit, and the pharmacy and over-the-counter purchases settled on its card ledger in the contract year.

1. Where the member holds a supplemental benefit card programme standing active and the pharmacy and over-the-counter purchases settled on its card in the contract year are at least that programme's own quarterly over-the-counter sublimit, the amount taken as met by the card is that sublimit.
2. Where the member holds a supplemental benefit card programme standing active and those settled purchases are below that programme's own quarterly over-the-counter sublimit, the amount taken as met by the card is the whole of those settled purchases.
3. Where neither holds, nothing is taken as met by a supplemental benefit card.

| Standing of the card programme | Settled pharmacy and over-the-counter purchases against that programme's quarterly sublimit | The amount taken as met by the card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Active | at or above the sublimit | the sublimit |
| Active | below the sublimit | the whole of those settled purchases |
| Not active, or no such programme is held | any | nothing |

Purchases settled at or exactly on the sublimit fall in the first row, not the second. Only purchases settled in the pharmacy and over-the-counter category, and only those actually settled, are counted; an entry that is not settled is not a purchase the card has met.

## Worked on a hypothetical holding

Take a card programme standing active whose quarterly over-the-counter sublimit is a hypothetical 90.00 USD.

- Settled pharmacy and over-the-counter purchases of 140.00 USD in the contract year: the amount taken as met by the card is 90.00 USD, the sublimit.
- Settled purchases of exactly 90.00 USD: the amount taken as met by the card is again 90.00 USD.
- Settled purchases of 35.00 USD: the amount taken as met by the card is 35.00 USD, the whole of them.
- The same programme standing anything other than active: nothing is taken as met by the card, whatever the ledger carries.
